prompts.name: Soft crop
prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: the provided original monochrome avatar. Produce ONE square 1254 by 1254 avatar on white, no text or contact sheet. Change ONLY its hairstyle; preserve precisely the same facial identity, eye/eyebrow/nose/mouth positions, face contour, head tilt and size, neck, collar, black clothing and shoulder outline. Match its minimal solid-black hand-ink illustration. IMPORTANT refinement: tidy, understated hair with moderate natural volume comparable to the original reference. Calm, composed contour, a handful of large smooth locks, no shag, no frizz, no exploding volume, no flyaway spikes, no sketchy hair lines, no fluffy cloud, no exaggerated wavy strands. Crown roughly at the original height (top about 90 out of 1254 pixels); do not enlarge the main hair mass above or much wider than the original. Keep a little lift at the roots, not slicked to the scalp or a geometric helmet. Smooth organic tapering tips; black-and-white only, very few white separations. Keep all facial features and body exactly as reference. New hair: a neat short softly layered side-part hairstyle, a few broad curved fringe locks gently swept diagonally across the forehead, natural rounded crown, orderly temple strands and compact tapered nape. No tousled shag and no curled-up tips. Elegant and simple with a controlled silhouette.
